messages:
ana: Uploaded a new compact inspector artboard for the rollout timeline. Main decision: show quick hover peek for mouse, require explicit open (Enter/click) for keyboard and tap on mobile. Thoughts?

mike: Hover peek is handy. Two product asks: make allocation language explicit (avoid bare numbers) and put a safe rollback flow behind a confirmation.

sam: Dev plan: CSS-only hover preview (opacity+translateY) + JS persistent inspector when clicked/Enter. Use aria-expanded on the node and role=region for the panel.

yvonne: Accessibility: hover-only content is a no-go for SR users. Add aria-describedby pointing to an offscreen description. For focus, require Enter to open; don't auto-open on focus. Contrast on the small chips needs bump to >=4.5:1.

mike: Microcopy: change "canary: 5%" -> "Canary  5% of traffic"? (typo) Better: "Canary  5% of traffic". Also append short version id like "· v42" to avoid confusion.

ana: I'll make copy precise: "Canary  5% of traffic · v42" and include a visually-hidden string: "Canary variant, serving five percent of traffic, version 42".

sam: Keyboard inside inspector: arrow keys navigate chips, Space toggles chip details, Esc closes and returns focus to the originating node. We'll add a 200ms hide delay on the hover preview to help motor-impaired users.

yvonne: For modal rollbacks ensure role=dialog, aria-labelledby, aria-describedby, and focus is moved in. For the inspector (non-modal) don't set aria-modal.

mike: UX: keep inline Revert as low-prominence icon text that opens confirmation. No one-click destructive actions.

deploy-bot: heads-up: feature flag compact-rollout-inspector enabled in staging tomorrow 16:00 UTC. Watch /deploys/rollout-inspector. :rocket:

ana: I'll update Figma and post the engineering checklist: 1) hover preview CSS + 200ms hide, 2) Enter/click opens persistent inspector (aria-expanded), 3) arrow nav + Space expand, 4) sr-only descriptions, 5) confirm modal semantics for rollback, 6) microcopy + contrast/padding tweaks. Close when PR links checklist. :thumbsup:
